content:
Maya (Finance): FYI — vendor sent invoice INV-2025-093 with 20% VAT applied but our EU billing entity is Redwood Inference SAS (FR123456789). PDF shows UK VAT (GB999999999) in the header. attaching screenshot from vendor portal.

invoice-bot: Invoice INV-2025-093 uploaded by Luc (Vendor) 2050123457

Maya (Finance): @Luc can you confirm which legal entity generated the invoice? we should not be charged VAT if we're B2B and they should reverse charge.

Luc (Vendor): Sorry — found bug in our ERP migration, template pulled GB VAT by mistake. We're actually registered in France (SAS) FR987654321 and can reissue the invoice correctly.

Priya (Accounting): Do we need a credit note + corrected invoice or will a reissued invoice alone let AP match the payment? our AP prefers a credit note referencing the original invoice.

Igor (Tax Counsel): If both supplier and customer are FR VAT-registered B2B, reverse charge applies for intra-EU B2B services/goods. Vendor should issue a credit note to cancel the original and a new invoice without VAT including the reverse charge statement. Also confirm vendor FR987654321 is active on VIES and our FR123456789 is included on the invoice.

Maya (Finance): I checked vendor profile — they do have FR987654321 on file but the exported PDF pulled the GB field. @Luc please reissue with: our billing name (Redwood Inference SAS), FR123456789 as our VAT, explicit net line amounts, and text 'Reverse charge / Autoliquidation TVA' or equivalent.

Luc (Vendor): Will do. We'll issue a credit note INV-2025-093-CN and a reissued invoice INV-2025-093-R (no VAT). ETA: EOD tomorrow. apologies for the noise :bow:

Priya (Accounting): Perfect — once we have CN + reissue AP can process. Also flagging that their beneficiary bank details changed during the ERP migration; we asked for new SWIFT/IBAN confirmation and a bank confirmation letter.

Maya (Finance): One more ask — vendor asked whether Redwood will gross up for any withholding tax they claim. i thought for FR-FR B2B there is no WHT, but want to be sure. @Igor?

Igor (Tax Counsel): Correct — no withholding tax on domestic FR B2B invoices for VAT; reverse charge covers the VAT. If they claim WHT for cross-border elements, we need a tax residency certificate and contract support. For this case, no gross-up required.

Maya (Finance): Thanks — I'll update the PO/ticket and wait for the CN + reissue.

invoice-bot: Ticket FIN-5561 updated: status=awaiting vendor reissue, assignee=Maya (Finance)
